welcome: [1mpi-brand[0m names your product inside pi: the model proposes names, you pick favorites, and it checks whether your favorites are taken.
This is real pi with the extension. The model, the web search and the domain lookups are scripted samples, so it needs no key.
pi opens by itself in an app that still needs a name. Press the first button above, then:
Space / a        mark a row / all filtered rows; Enter opens details
f / d            favorite or discard highlighted / marked names
Tab / Left/Right switch Names, Favorites and History
b                reveal the brief; e edits, f gives feedback
n                manually add a name without generating or checking
g                prepare generation; Enter explicitly starts
c / Shift+C      check pending / recheck all (or marked rows)
Esc              back or close; /brand resumes without generating
Change the theme at the top right and pi follows it.
hints: /brand a reminder app that tells you when to water each plant
